description: Returns the current status of a letter (awaiting_payment, paid, submitted, in_transit, delivered, failed, expired, ...), its timeline and, once available, proof links (proof of deposit for "registered", proof of delivery for "registered_ar"). No account is needed; the letter_id is the credential. Recipient details are partially redacted unless the request carries the API key that created the letter.
name: get_letter_status
title: Follow a letter
